Daily X Report — 2026-10-31. Theme of the day: agents move into everyday developer tools while the AI funding climate cools. On the AI side, privacy and safety take center stage — OpenAI's enterprise privacy offering and Anthropic's automated red-teaming research — while agents land in developers' daily tools: Antigravity enters Android Studio with a new plugin marketplace, and Runway Agent can now open files and run code. On the finance side, the mood cools: OpenAI cuts its fundraising target and valuation, US consumer financial expectations deteriorate to a record, Nasdaq 100 ETF shorts hit their highest since March 2023, and China's factory activity contracts again alongside an extended Russian diesel export ban.

AI Practical / Agents:
1. OpenAI: Private Intelligence for enterprises — privacy should advance with intelligence; enterprises get stronger data control while using the most capable models. https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2116186509384815084
2. Anthropic: Automated red-teaming with Claude — thousands of Claude agents attempt to evade training-data monitors, testing whether automated red-teaming is feasible. https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2116349211549843666
3. Google Antigravity: Agentic capabilities enter Android Studio — agent capabilities extend into Android development tooling. https://x.com/antigravity/status/2116232874328281451
4. Google Antigravity: New plugin marketplace — easier discovery of plugins, a direct developer-workflow update. https://x.com/antigravity/status/2115852199502684342

AI Video / World Models:
5. Runway: Agent can open files and run code — beyond generating content, Runway Agent builds brand launch kits and creates product images, ad variants and motion graphics from reference images. https://x.com/runwayml/status/2116227954518978729

Finance & Markets:
6. The Kobeissi Letter: US consumer financial expectations hit record worst — a record 41% of consumers expect their finances to worsen over the next 12 months, more than triple since Q2 2024 and above the 2008 crisis peak of 23%. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116313518911668301
7. The Kobeissi Letter: S&P cuts Meta outlook to negative — citing significant uncertainty around CapEx and free operating cash flow, with leverage possibly above 1.0x. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116280985612636573
8. The Kobeissi Letter: Nasdaq 100 ETF shorts highest since March 2023 — about 82M shares short, up 18M (+28%) in recent weeks and nearly doubled year to date, while S&P 500 ETF shorts have fallen since March. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116271956987154764
9. The Kobeissi Letter: OpenAI cuts fundraising target and valuation — target cut by $10B and valuation by $150B, corroborating Bloomberg's reporting on a cooling AI funding climate. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116357848464601125
10. Bloomberg: China factory activity contracts again in October — underscoring the challenge for policymakers in meeting the full-year growth target. https://x.com/business/status/2116349517603774706
11. Bloomberg: Russia extends diesel export ban to end of January — the blanket ban on producer diesel exports is extended, though some volumes still reach global markets. https://x.com/business/status/2116506752988361072

Note: X search/explore pages are login-walled without sign-in; this report's material was collected from public profile pages, which show only about the first 5 posts when logged out. Only one evening addition (finance) is new; other evening candidates were already in the 2026-10-30 pool and were deduplicated. All links are original post URLs.

今日推特精选报告（2026-10-31）

总览：今天的主线是“智能体走进日常开发工具”与“AI 融资环境转冷”两条线交汇。AI 一边继续讲隐私与安全——OpenAI 的企业级隐私方案、Anthropic 的自动化红队研究相继出现，一边把智能体塞进开发者的日常工具：Antigravity 进入 Android Studio 并新增插件市场，Runway Agent 则能打开文件、跑代码。金融线则明显降温：OpenAI 融资目标与估值双双下调、美国消费者财务预期恶化至创纪录水平、Nasdaq 100 ETF 空头创两年多新高，叠加中国工厂活动再度收缩与俄罗斯柴油出口禁令延长，宏观与供给侧信号都不轻松。

一、AI 实用用法 / Agent
1. OpenAI：企业级隐私方案 Private Intelligence（10月30日晚）——提出隐私应与智能同步进步，介绍 OpenAI Private Intelligence 如何让企业在使用最强模型时获得更强的数据控制，是官方企业级隐私方向公告。
https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2116186509384815084
2. Anthropic：Claude 自动化红队研究（10月31日上午）——新研究用数千个 Claude agent 尝试规避训练数据监测器，检验自动化红队的可行性，是具体的安全研究方法而非泛泛表态。
https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2116349211549843666
3. Google Antigravity：智能体能力进入 Android Studio（10月31日凌晨）——宣布 Antigravity 的智能体能力进入 Android Studio，是智能体开发能力向 Android 开发工具扩展的具体落地。
https://x.com/antigravity/status/2116232874328281451
4. Google Antigravity：新增插件市场（10月30日）——宣布 Antigravity 新增插件市场，更便于搜索与发现插件，是直接可用的开发工作流更新。
https://x.com/antigravity/status/2115852199502684342

二、AI 视频 / 世界模型
5. Runway：Agent 可打开文件并运行代码（10月31日凌晨）——Runway Agent 不再只生成内容，还能打开文件并运行代码，可构建品牌发布工具包，并根据参考图创建产品图、广告变体、动态图形，是明确的智能体工作流扩展。
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2116227954518978729

三、金融市场
6. The Kobeissi Letter：美国消费者财务预期创纪录恶化（10月31日上午）——创纪录的 41% 美国消费者预计未来 12 个月财务状况恶化，自 2024 年第二季度以来增长两倍多，高于 2008 年金融危机时 23% 的峰值，并配有长期图表。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116313518911668301
7. The Kobeissi Letter：标普下调 Meta 展望（10月31日上午）——标普全球将 Meta（$META）展望下调至“negative”，理由是 CapEx 和自由经营现金流存在显著不确定性，并提到杠杆可能超过 1.0x、自由现金流可能更久为负，直接关联市场对 AI 资本开支的担忧。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116280985612636573
8. The Kobeissi Letter：Nasdaq 100 ETF 空头创 2023 年 3 月以来最高（10月31日上午）——Nasdaq 100 ETF（$QQQ）空头头寸约 8200 万股，为 2023 年 3 月以来最高，近几周增加 1800 万股（+28%），年初以来接近翻倍；同时对比标普 500 ETF（$SPY）空头自 3 月以来下降，是判断科技股拥挤程度的有用数据点。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116271956987154764
9. The Kobeissi Letter：OpenAI 融资目标与估值双双下调（10月31日）——报道 OpenAI 融资目标下调 100 亿美元、估值下调 1500 亿美元，与彭博的融资新闻相互印证，是判断 AI 融资环境变化的直接信号。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116357848464601125
10. Bloomberg：中国 10 月工厂活动再度收缩（10月31日上午）——中国 10 月工厂活动再度收缩，凸显政策制定者在实现全年增长目标上面临的挑战，是当日重要的宏观数据信号。
https://x.com/business/status/2116349517603774706
11. Bloomberg：俄罗斯柴油出口禁令延长至 1 月底（10月31日晚）——俄罗斯把生产商柴油出口的普遍禁令延长至 1 月底，同时仍允许部分产量流向全球市场，属能源/大宗商品供给侧消息。
https://x.com/business/status/2116506752988361072

说明：X 搜索/探索页未登录会被登录墙拦截，本报告素材来自公开主页刷取；未登录状态下各主页仅显示约前 5 条帖，故更早的帖子未能核实。晚场新增仅 1 条金融类，其余晚场候选均已在 2026-10-30 素材池中，按去重规则未重复计入。链接均为原帖地址。
